verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only built-in, pre-mapped controls and a fixed list of supported frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS). Nothing documents creating custom frameworks or custom controls with user-defined tests or evidence requirements. Custom fields in AI-system configuration and ingestion webhooks are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a security engineer, I can add custom frameworks and custom controls with my own tests and evidence requirements alongside the built-in ones
